mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate, as measured by FEDFUNDS, indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate, defined as a rise exceeding 0.5 percentage points over a 3-month period, signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending power, which depresses corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE rises by more than 0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates robust consumer demand and economic expansion, which boosts corporate revenues and investor confidence, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both above 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO < 100), which indicates a contraction in manufacturing and supply chain disruptions, the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate profits are pressured by reduced output and higher input costs.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is below 100.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp acceleration in inflation, defined as a 3-month CPIAUCSL increase exceeding 0.5 percentage points, signals the Federal Reserve may tighten monetary policy, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL rises by more than 0.5pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: A robust quarterly GDP growth rate, as measured by GDPC1, indicates a strong economy with rising corporate earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of quarters when GDPC1 growth is above 2.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in employment (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate profits, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS above 3-month moving average and UNRATE below 3-month moving average
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS is above its 3-month moving average and UNRATE is below its 3-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%), the S&P 500 experiences negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the cost of capital rises and economic growth slows, reflecting the market's sensitivity to monetary policy tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 4.5%.
